destructive.title: Confirm destructive statements
destructive.description: This connection is a production environment. The statements below can destroy data and cannot be undone.

reason.deleteWithoutWhere: DELETE without WHERE: removes every row
reason.updateWithoutWhere: UPDATE without WHERE: changes every row
reason.flushDb: Removes every key of the database
reason.flushAll: Removes every key of every database
reason.deleteManyAll: deleteMany with an empty filter: removes every document
reason.updateManyAll: updateMany with an empty filter: changes every document
